::: {.news-item}
<span class="news-date">November 2026</span> <span class="news-tag tag-project">Dissemination</span>

**New section: Practical guides.** The first [practical guide](guides.qmd) explains how to estimate Theil indices in R, decompose them by groups (regions, sex) and measure their bias and precision. Available in English and Spanish.
:::

::: {.news-item}
<span class="news-date">November 2026</span> <span class="news-tag tag-project">Conferences</span>

**Conferences of interest in 2027.** The [Dissemination page](dissemination.qmd#upcoming-conferences-2027) lists conferences with confirmed dates: III/LIS (February, London), IARIW–WIUT (May, Tashkent; abstracts due 25 November 2026), EcoSta (July, Shanghai), ISI World Statistics Congress (July, Lusaka), ESRA (July, Paris), ECINEQ (September, Helsinki) and EnvStat (September, Vienna).
:::
